name: Fear of the Void Below (Daimoinon, Basic)

system.description: Requires the Baali to have used Sense the Sin on the target within the prior night, gaining one Trait per Trait beyond the first risked in that challenge. The Baali then engages the target in a Social Challenge, verbally assaulting the target's hidden sin. A one-Trait success leaves the target trembling until the assault ends; two Traits causes the target to flee as if suffering Rotschreck; three Traits causes the target to faint into unconsciousness. The target may avert the effect with a Courage Test.
